targets.rawSql:
SELECT device_name AS device, name, labels->>'kind' AS kind, status, since, last_output
  FROM check_objects_v
 WHERE tenant_id = '$tenant' AND check_id IN ($check) AND gone_at IS NULL AND status <> 'OK'
 ORDER BY status = 'OK', device_name, name

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(m.time, $__interval), (SELECT coalesce(s.object_name, nullif(s.object, ''), s.check_name) FROM metric_series_v s WHERE s.series_id = m.series_id) AS metric, (avg(value)) * 1 AS value
  FROM metrics_raw m
 WHERE m.tenant_id = '$tenant' AND m.check_id IN ($check) AND m.name = 'power_watts' AND m.object LIKE 'pdu:%' AND $__timeFilter(m.time) AND $__interval_ms < 300000
 GROUP BY 1, 2
UNION ALL
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(m.time, $__interval), (SELECT coalesce(s.object_name, nullif(s.object, ''), s.check_name) FROM metric_series_v s WHERE s.series_id = m.series_id) AS metric, (sum(sum) / sum(count)) * 1 AS value
  FROM metrics_5m m
 WHERE m.tenant_id = '$tenant' AND m.check_id IN ($check) AND m.name = 'power_watts' AND m.object LIKE 'pdu:%' AND $__timeFilter(m.time) AND $__interval_ms >= 300000 AND $__interval_ms < 3600000
 GROUP BY 1, 2
UNION ALL
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(m.time, $__interval), (SELECT coalesce(s.object_name, nullif(s.object, ''), s.check_name) FROM metric_series_v s WHERE s.series_id = m.series_id) AS metric, (sum(sum) / sum(count)) * 1 AS value
  FROM metrics_1h m
 WHERE m.tenant_id = '$tenant' AND m.check_id IN ($check) AND m.name = 'power_watts' AND m.object LIKE 'pdu:%' AND $__timeFilter(m.time) AND $__interval_ms >= 3600000
 GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1
